$comment: M70 content contract for data/<namespace>/dungeon_bag/*.json. Identity is the resource id namespace + the relative path with the .json suffix stripped (data/mypack/dungeon_bag/my_bag.json is the bag mypack:my_bag). The parser is BagMeta.fromJson. The kit (one roll of loot_table) is handed over once, when the bag is chosen at the bag chest; kit_baseline is what each safe visit tops up toward.

version.$comment: Content contract version this file declares. 1 is the only generation accepted.

label.$comment: Display name in the bag picker.

blurb.$comment: One line under the label in the picker.

order.$comment: Stable picker order. Bags sort by order, then by id; the built-ins use 0 to 7.

headline.$comment: Namespaced item ids the door frames show and the cube catalyst lookup matches against.

tags.$comment: Situation tags this bag seeds the solvability pass with. Closed vocabulary (SituationTags); an unknown tag rejects the file at load.

loot_table.$comment: The kit table. Defaults to <namespace>:bags/<path>. Rejected at load if the table does not exist.

kit_baseline.$comment: The deterministic kit a safe visit tops up toward: deficit = count minus what the player holds of that item type (tagged or not) in their dungeon inventory and in their saved rooms. Stackable lines restore floor(deficit x band fraction x zone kit_top_up_scale); durability lines are replaced only when missing, only at the calm band, and never repaired. Omitted or empty means the bag is never topped up. /dungeon admin validate reports a line above what one roll of loot_table gives, an unknown item, and a durability mark that does not match the item.

item.$comment: Namespaced item id. Each item may appear once.

durability.$comment: True for a tool or other item with durability: replaced only when missing, at the calm band only, and a damaged one is never repaired. Must match the item.

empties_into.$comment: The item a used one leaves behind (minecraft:bucket for a water, lava or milk bucket). The top-up turns a held empty back into the kit item instead of minting a new one beside it, and mints only when no empty is held anywhere.
